gloss: experience points (in games); level of experience

definitions.gloss: experience points (in games); level of experience
definitions.explanation: a numerical value representing accumulated experience, originally from video games but now widely used figuratively to describe real-life experience and skill

examples.japanese: {経験値|けいけんち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{稼|かせ}ぐ→稼ぐ：02040_kasegu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{経験値|けいけんち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
examples.english: He still has a low level of experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{経験値|けいけんち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Working abroad raised my experience level.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{経験値|けいけんち}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}えば→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{気|き}が{楽|らく}→気が楽：19541_kigaraku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you think of failures as experience points, it's easier to accept them.

notes:
Originally a gaming term (often abbreviated as EXP), {経験値|けいけんち} has crossed over into everyday Japanese to describe accumulated real-world experience. The gaming metaphor is alive in everyday speech — people talk about "leveling up" their experience.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経験値|けいけんち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{稼|かせ}ぐ→稼ぐ：02040_kasegu⟧: to earn experience (points)
- {経験値|けいけんち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: experience level goes up
- {経験値|けいけんち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: to have high/low experience
- {経験値|けいけんち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧: to build up experience

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: experience (the general word); {経験値|けいけんち} adds the nuance of quantifiable, accumulated skill
- ⟦{実績|じっせき}→実績：04214_jisseki⟧: track record or achievements; focuses on concrete results rather than accumulated learning
- {熟練度|じゅくれんど}: proficiency level; more formal and focused on skill mastery

FORMS:
⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧ (experience) + {値|ち} (value, numerical value).
